rows.title: Missing amount asks
rows.defect: a missing amount silently defaults to the last amount ($40)
rows.test: a send without an amount asks and stages nothing

rows.title: Amounts parse exactly
rows.defect: thousands separators are not stripped, so "1,800" is not a number
rows.test: every common amount form becomes exact cents, words and zero ask, memo numbers ignored

rows.title: Saved recipient resolves, ambiguity asks
rows.defect: an ambiguous first name picks the first match instead of asking
rows.test: name, first name or handle resolve; two matches ask which

rows.title: Strangers and look-alikes never pass as saved
rows.defect: the look-alike check only fires on an exact match (distance 0)
rows.test: unknown names go to the new-recipient path; near handles are named as look-alikes

rows.title: Free rail first, fees and timing shown
rows.defect: rail selection prefers the fastest rail over the free one
rows.test: the free reachable rail is chosen; gated rails never offered; instant is opt-in

rows.title: Confirmation restates five fields, nothing written before yes
rows.defect: the fee is dropped from the confirmation text
rows.test: action, amount, recipient with handle, funding, fee and timing in one confirmation; zero writes

rows.title: Plain yes approves, qualified yes corrects
rows.defect: "yes, but ..." is classified as a plain approval
rows.test: "yes" executes exactly; "yes but $45" re-confirms the corrected send with no write

rows.title: A new amount without a yes corrects
rows.defect: an amount change that is not a qualified yes falls through to "Yes or no?" with the old card (found live 2026-10-11)
rows.test: "actually make it $50" replaces the $40 card with a $50 one; no write

rows.title: No means nothing changed
rows.defect: a declined confirmation falls through and executes anyway
rows.test: no, stop, never mind clear the pending send; no write

rows.title: Stale approval is not approval
rows.test: a yes after fifteen minutes is refused; no write

rows.title: Same instruction twice means once
rows.defect: the completed-key check before the gate is disabled
rows.test: two deliveries of the same send write once; the second says already done

rows.title: Crash between write and receipt never double-sends
rows.defect: recovery re-executes the write instead of reading back
rows.test: after a crash the next wake reconciles by read-back; one write

rows.title: Timeouts are unknown, rejections are failures
rows.defect: a write that threw is assumed to have gone through
rows.test: a timeout is unknown with a follow-up; a rejection is failed with the reason

rows.title: Scam and injection stop before the confirmation
rows.defect: the scam pattern check is switched off
rows.test: a scam phrase stops and names itself; memo instructions are text

rows.title: Limits and the kill switch hold
rows.defect: the velocity check result is ignored
rows.test: over the daily or weekly limit stops; paused blocks without asking

rows.title: Receipts only after the rail confirms; staging is never sent
rows.defect: a receipt can be issued without a rail confirmation or a posting record
rows.test: partner receipt only after verify with the reversal contract; handoff is staged then landed

rows.title: Stop-on-change
rows.defect: the re-verification result is ignored, so a changed rail still sends
rows.test: a changed rail, fee or limit between yes and send stops it

rows.title: A share of what
rows.defect: the share words are not read
rows.test: send Sam my share asks share of what
